CONTRACT FOR 
 MEP DESIGN CONSULTANCY SERVICES 
 
 
 Between 
 
 
 ZUI Investments 
 
 And 
 
 Jers Consultancy (Pvt) Ltd 
 
 
 For 
 
 
 Zameen ACE Mall, Islamabad 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 This MEP Design Consultancy Services Contract (hereinafter called the "Contract" ) is made at Lahore on this 09 th day of July, 2020 
 
 BY AND BETWEEN 
 
 ZUI Investments , a partnership having its registered office at Pearl One, 94-B/I, M. M. Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore, Pakistan through its authorized representative s (1) Fahad Arif Khawaja s /o Khawaja Arif Mahmood , holder of CNIC No. 35202-2881321-3 and (2) Adil Kamal , holder of CNIC No. 31202-9247547-3 (hereinafter called the " Client " which expression shall wherever the context so requires or include its successors, legal representatives and permitted assigns). 
 
 AND 
 
 Jers Consultancy (Pvt) Ltd., having its office at 24 Civic Center Township, Lahore through its authorized representative Imran Yasin Sheikh s/o Sheikh Muhaamad Yashin holder of CNIC No. 35202-4484331-3 ( hereinafter called the " Consultant " which expression shall wherever the context so requires or include its successors, legal representatives and permitted assigns). 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 (The Client and the Consultant hereinafter individually referred to as “ Party ” and collectively as “ Parties ”). 
 
 WHEREAS 
 
 The Client is the owner and developer of a real estate project named and styled as “ Zameen Ace Mall” located at Street No. 15A Sector-J Phase II DHA, Islamabad (hereinafter referred to as the Project ); 
 
 The Consultant is engaged in the business of designing of water, plumbing and electricity systems and ha ve represented to the Client that they have the necessary professional skills, experience, qualifications, personnel and technical resources to perform the Services contemplated under this Contract. 
 
 Relying on the warranties and representations given by the Consultant , the Client is desirous of availing and the Consultant has agreed to provide design consultancy services to the Client as more specifically defined in Appendix A of this Contract (hereinafter called the " Services ") on the terms and conditions set forth in this Contract. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 NOW THEREFORE , the Parties hereby agree as follows: 
 
 Definitions 
 Unless the context otherwise requires, the following terms whenever used in this Contract have the following meanings: 
 
 "Applicable Law" means the laws and any other instruments having the force of law in the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, as those may be issued and in force from time to time; 
 
 "Contract" means this Contract signed by the Parties, together with all the documents listed in Clause 9.2 ; 
 
 "Contract Price" means the price to be paid by the Client to the Consultant for the performance of the Services, in accordance with Clause 6.1 ; 
 
 "Effective Date" means the date on which this Contract comes into force and effect pursuant to Clause 2.1 ; 
 
 "Government" means the Government of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan and/or p rovincial g overnment(s); 
 
 “ MEP ” means Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing; 
 
 "Personnel" means persons hired by the Consultant as employees and assigned to the performance of the Services or any part thereof; 
 
 " Services " means the services to be performed by the Consultant , pursuant to this Contract as more fully described in Appendix A; 
 “ Site ” means the site where the Project is located, more specifically at Street No. 15A Sector-J Phase II DHA, Islamabad; 
 
 " Sub Consultant " means any entity to which the Consultant subcontract s any part of the Services; and 
 
 "Third Party" means any person or entity other than the Client or Consultant . 
 
 1.2 Law Governing the Contract 
 
 This Contract, its meaning and interpretation, and the relation between the Parties shall be governed by the Applicable Law. 
 
 1.3 Language 
 
 This Contract has been executed in the English language which shall be the binding and controlling language for all matters relating to the meaning or interpretation of this Contract. All the reports and communications shall be in the English language. 
 
 1.4 Notices 
 
 Any notice, request, or consent made pursuant to this Contract shall be in writing and shall be deemed to have been made when delivered in person to the Party to whom the communication is addressed, or when sent by registered mail, telex, or facsimile to such Party at the registered address of th e Parties specified herein . A Party may change its address for notice hereunder by giving the other Party notice of such change. 
 
 1. 5 Taxes 
 
 All payments made by the Client to the Consultant under this Contract shall be subject to deduction of only withholding income t ax and the C ontract Price is exclusive of any other taxes applicable in accordance with the Applicable Law. 
 
 1. 6 Relation between the Parties 
 
 Nothing contained herein shall be construed as establishing a relation of master and servant or of principal and agent as between the Client and the Consultant . The Consultant , subject to this Contract, have complete charge of Personnel and Subconsultants, if any, performing the Services and shall be fully responsible for the Services performed by them or on their behalf hereunder. 
 
 1.10 Headings 
 
 The headings shall not limit, alter or affect the meaning of this Contract. 
 
 2. COMMENCEMENT, COMPLETION, MODIFICATION, AND TERMINATION OF CONTRACT 
 
 2.1 Effectiveness of Contract 
 
 This Contract shall come into force and effect on the date of signing of the Contract by both the Parties. 
 
 2. 2 Expiration of Contract 
 
 Unless terminated earlier, this Contract shall expire when, pursuant to the provisions hereof, the Services have been completed by the Consultant as specified in Appendix A of the Contract to the full satisfaction of the Client and the payment of the Contract Price ha s been made by the Client in accordance with this Contract . 
 
 2. 3 Modification 
 
 Modification of the terms and conditions of this Contract, including any modification of the scope of the Services or of the Contract Price, shall only be effective mutually agreed in writing between the Parties. 
 
 2. 4 Force Majeure 
 
 For the purposes of this Contract, "Force Majeure" means an event which is beyond the reasonable control of a Party and which makes a Party's performance of its obligations under the Contract impossible or so impractical as to be considered impossible under the circumstances, and includes, but is not limited to, war, riots, civil disorder, earthquake, pandemic, fire, explosion, storm, flood or other adverse weather conditions, strikes, lockouts or other industrial actions (except where such strikes, lockouts or other industrial actions are within the power of the Party invoking Force Majeure to prevent), confiscation or any other action by government agencies. 
 
 Force Majeure shall not include ( i ) any event which is caused by the negligence or intentional action of a Party or such Party's Subconsultant or agents or employees, nor (ii) any event which a diligent Party could reasonably have been expected to both (A) take into account at the time of the conclusion of this Contract and (B) avoid or overcome in the carrying out of its obligations hereunder. 
 
 The failure of a Party to fulfill any of its obligations under the Contract shall not be considered to be a breach of, or default under this Contract insofar as such inability arises from an event of Force Majeure, provided that the Party affected by such an event; (a) has taken all reasonable precautions, due care and reasonable alternative measures in order to carry out the terms and conditions of this Contract; and (b) has informed the other Party in writing no later than fifteen (15) days following the occurrence of such an event. 
 
 Any period within which a Party shall, pursuant to this Contract, complete any action or task, shall be extended for a period equal to the time during which such Party was unable to perform such action as a result of Force Majeure. 
 
 During the period of their inability to perform the Services as a result of an event of Force Majeure, the Consultant shall be not be entitled to any payment under the terms of this Contract . 
 
 2. 5 Suspension of Payments by the Client 
 
 The Client may, by written notice of suspension to the Consultant , suspend all payments to the Consultant hereunder if the Consultant fail s to perform any of their obligations under this Contract, including the carrying out of the Services, provided that such notice of suspension ( i ) shall specify the nature of the failure, and (ii) shall request the Consultant to remedy such failure within a period not exceeding fifteen ( 1 5 ) days after receipt by the Consultant of such notice of suspension. 
 
 Termination 
 
 The Client may terminate this Contract, by a written notice of termination to the Consultant : 
 
 Immediately on expiry of the suspension notice given under Clause 2. 5 or any other period subsequently specified by the Client; 
 
 if the Consultant become s insolvent or bankrupt or enter into any agreement with their creditors for relief of debt or take advantage of any law for the benefit of debtors or go into liquidation or receivership whether compulsory or voluntary; 
 
 if the Consultant fail s to comply with any final decision reached as a result of arbitration proceedings pursuant to Clause 8.2 hereof; 
 
 in the event of breach of any representation or warranty made by the Consultant ; or 
 
 if, as the result of Force Majeure, the Consultant is unable to perform a material portion of the Services for a period of not less than thirty (30) days . 
 
 The Client may terminate the Contract at any time by giving the Consultant ten (10) days written notice to terminate the Contract. 
 
 The Consultant may terminate this Contract, by giving not less than thirty (30) days ’ written notice to the Client: 
 
 if the Client fails to pay any monies due to the Consultant pursuant to this Contract , except to the extent of or in relation to a dispute pursuant to Clause 8 or due to a notice under Clause 6.4 ; 
 
 if the Client is in material breach of its obligations pursuant to this Contract and has not remedied the same within forty-five (45) days (or such longer period as the Parties may have subsequently agree to in writing) following the receipt by the Client of the Consultant ' s written notice specifying such breach; 
 
 if the Client fails to comply with any final decision reached as a result of arbitration proceedings pursuant to Clause 8.2 hereof. 
 
 
 Cessation of Services 
 
 Upon termination of the Contract, the Consultant shall take all necessary steps to bring the Services to a close in a prompt and orderly manner and shall make every reasonable effort to keep expenditures (if any) for this purpose to a minimum. With respect to documents prepared by the Consultant , the Consultant shall proceed as provided under C lause 3.6 below. 
 
 
 Payment upon Termination 
 
 Upon termination of this Contract , the Client shall pay to the Consultant only for the Services satisfactorily performed by the Consultant prior to the effective date of termination , subject to any offset, adjustment and/or deduction under this Agreement . The e ffective date of termination for purposes of this Clause 2.8 shall be the date when the prescribed notice period expire s. In the event the Contract is terminated before the advance paid by the Client at the time of signing of this Contract to the Consultant is utilized, the Consultant shall be liable to reimburse the Client any such unutilized amount immediately upon termination of the Contract. 
 
 3. OBLIGATIONS OF THE CONSULTANT 
 
 Standard of Performance 
 
 The Consultant shall perform the Services and carry out its obligations , under this Contract , with all due diligence, efficiently and in accordance with the timelines provided herein and specifically in Appendix A . 
 
 
 The Consultant shall perform the Services in accordance with recognized professional and industry standards, and shall be fit for the intended purpose, free of defect(s) and/or deficiency( ies ). 
 
 The Consultant shall always act, in respect of any matter relating to this Contract or to the Services, as faithful advisers to the Client, and shall at all times support and safeguard the Client's legitimate interests . 
 
 Law Governing Services 
 
 The Consultant shall perform the Services in accordance with the Applicable Law and shall take all practicable steps to ensure that any Personnel or S ubconsultants (if any) , also comply with the Applicable Law. 
 
 Confidentiality 
 
 The existence and the terms and conditions of this Contract and any information, data, documents, figures, calculations , either in writing or orally, electronically or through paper documentation shared between the Parties or disclosed by the Client in connection with the preparation and/ or performance of this Contract shall be regarded as confidential information by the Consultant . The Consultant shall take all reasonable measures not disclose any such confidential information to any third parties without obtaining the prior written consent of the Client, except where such disclosure is required under the law. 
 
 T he Consultant (including their Personnel) shall take reasonable measures to protect all such confidential information shared under this Contract and shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless the Client against any losses, claims, damages, fees or charges arising out of any breach by the Consultant of the confidentiality obligations under this Contract. 
 
 This clause shall survive the expiry and termination of this Contract. 
 
 Liability of the Consultant 
 
 
 The Con sultant shall take full responsibility for the adequacy, stability, sufficiency, accuracy and safety of all design s submitted under this Contract and/or the consequence and risks of errors and omissions therein . 
 
 If the Client suffers any direct or indirect losses , risks, costs or damages as a result of faults, errors or omissions in the design (s) submitted by the Consultant under the Contract , the Consultant shall make good such losses or damages . 
 
 The liability of the Consultant with respect to the design(s) submitted and Services performed under this Contract shall be for a period of fi ve (5) years from the expiry of this Contract , provided that the design (s) submitted under the Contract remain intact and no changes , except the ones pre-approved by the Consultant, have been made by Client ’s resident team to the C onsultant’s submitted design (s) . 
 
 The Client might hire, at its own cost and expense, a third-party independent consultant to vet and review all design submitted by the Consultant under th is Contract. In the event any discrepancies, errors and/ or deficiencies are discovered by the third-party independent consultant, the Consultant shall be liable to cure and remedy all such any discrepancies, errors and/ or deficiencies, at its own cost and expense, to the satisfaction of the Client. 
 
 
 All design(s) submitted under this Contract shall be in compliance with the best engineering practices. 
 
 Consultant ' s Actions Requiring Client's Prior Approval 
 
 The Consultant shall obtain the Client's prior approval , in writing before taking any of the following actions: 
 
 appointing such Personnel as are listed in Appendix B for the term of this Contract ; and 
 
 entering into a subcontract for the performance of any part of the Services, it being understood ( i ) that the selection of Sub -C onsultants and the terms and conditions of the subcontract shall have been approved in writing by the Client prior to the execution of the subcontract, and (ii) that the Consultant shall remain fully liable for the performance of the Services by the Subconsultants pursuant to this Contract . 
 
 Documents Prepared by the Consultant to be the Property of the Client 
 
 T he Consultant and its Sub-c onsultants hereby assign to the Client all rights , including, without limitation, c opyrights, patents, trade secret rights, and any other intellectual property rights whatsoever associated with a ll plans, drawings, specifications, reports, and other documents and software prepared and submitted by the Consultant under this Contract . The Consultant shall, immediately upon termination or expiration of this Contract, deliver (if not already delivered) all such documents and software to the Client, together with a detailed inventory thereof. Upon termination or expiration of the Contract, the Consultant and its Sub- Consultants , shall destroy or return to the Client (as directed by the Client) all such documents, data or information prepared and submitted by the Consultant under this Contract, save to the extent that it is required to retain by the Applicable Law or government authority( ies ). 
 
 Accounting, Inspection and Auditing 
 
 The Consultant ( i ) s hall keep accurate and systematic accounts and records in respect of the Services hereunder, in accordance with and in such form and manner as internationally accepted accounting standards and principles ; and (ii) shall permit the Client or its designated representatives periodically, and up to six (6) from the expiration or termination of this Contract, to inspect the same and make copies thereof as well . 
 
 CONSULTANT ' S PERSONNEL AND SUB CONSULTANTS 
 
 The Consultant shall not subcontract the whole or any part of the Works without the prior written consent of the Client , provided that the Consultant shall be solely liable for all acts, defaults, negligence, omission etc. of such sub- consultants . Any hiring or employment of Sub- Consultants by the Consultant for the performance of Services shall not create any legal relationship between the Client and such independent employees or Sub- Consultants of the Consultant. The Client shall be entitled to withhold its consent as to hiring or employment of any such Sub- consultant(s) and the Consultant shall not employ or hire services of such independent Sub- consultants , with regard to whom consent was not given by the Client. 
 
 The Consultant may employ or hire such qualified and experienced Personnel as are required to carry out the Services , subject to such prior approvals as may be required under this Contract . 
 
 The Consultant shall not, without the prior consent of the Client (which consent shall be at the sole discretion of the Client ), assign the Contract or any part thereof, or any beneﬁt or interest therein or thereunder to any third party. 
 
 Description , Qualifications and Approval of Personnel 
 
 The designation , job description , responsibilities and estimated period of engagement in the carrying out of the Services of each of the Consultant ' s Personnel are described in Appendix B . 
 
 The Personnel and Subconsultants listed by designation as well as by name in Appendix B are deemed to be approved by the Client. In respect of other Personnel which the Consultant propose to use in carrying out of the Services, the Consultant shall submit to the Client for review and approval a copy of their biographical data . If the Client does not object to the engagement of the Personnel in writing within fourteen (14) calendar days from the date of receipt of such biographical data, such Personnel shall be deemed to have been approved by the Client. 
 
 Removal and/or Replacement of Personnel 
 
 Except as the Client may otherwise agree, no changes shall be made in the Personnel approved by the Client in Appendix B . If, for any reason beyond the reasonable control of the Consultant , it becomes necessary to replace any of the Personnel, the Consultant shall provide as a replacement a person of equivalent or better qualifications. 
 
 If the Client; ( i ) finds that any of the Personnel has committed serious misconduct or has been charged with having committed a criminal action; or (ii) has reasonable cause to be dissatisfied with the performance of any of the Personnel, then the Consultant shall, at the Client's written request specifying the grounds therefor, provide as a replacement a person with qualifications and experience acceptable to the Client. 
 
 If required by the Client , the Consultant shall ensure that at all times during the Consultant ' s performance of the Services, a Resident Engineer acceptable to the Client, shall take charge of the performance of such Services . The Resident Engineer shall be hired at the cost and expense of the Client and shall carry out detailed resident supervision of the Services on Site . 
 
 Except as the Client may otherwise agree, the Consultant shall; ( i ) bear all the additional travel and other costs arising out of or incidental to any removal and/or replacement of Personnel ; and (ii) bear any additional remuneration, to be paid for any of the Personnel provided as a replacement to that of the Personnel being replaced. 
 
 Site Visit 
 
 The Consultant or their Personnel shall visit the Site (for top supervision) as and when requested by the Client to inspect the MEP works at Site . Twenty-Four ( 24 ) visits by the Consultant or their Personnel shall be the part of this C ontract. 
 
 If Client requires additional visits to Site in order to monitor, control and coordinate the progress of the Project, for each additional visit, the Consultant shall charge a sum of Rupees Twenty-Five Thousand (PKR 25,000 ) which shall be in addition to the of boarding &amp; lodgings charges incurred . 
 
 Additional Services 
 
 The Consultant may be required by the Client to perform additional services. Additional services may include: 
 
 Services as approved by the Client outside the scope of Services described in Appendix A; 
 
 Services to be performed during the period extended beyond the initial timelines scheduled f or the completion of Services; and 
 
 any redesign with respect to any part of the Services as a result of Client's instructions. 
 
 If, in the opinion of the Client, it is necessary to perform additional services during the validity of the Contract for the purpose of the Project, the Consultant , with the prior written authorization of the Client, shall carry out such additional services on the basis of the billing rates set out in the Contract. In case for any reasons these rates and prices are determined by both the Parties to be not applicable for said additional services, then suitable billing rates and the additional time, shall be agreed upon in writing between Parties. 
 
 R epresentations &amp; Warranties by the Consultant 
 
 Without prejudice to any other warranties and representations expressed elsewhere in the Contract, the Consultant represent s and warrant s to the Clients that the Services performed under the Contract: 
 
 shall be executed with skill and care to be expected of appropriately qualified and experienced c onsultant with experience in carrying services of a similar type, nature and complexity of the Services; 
 
 shall be completed and executed in accordance with the requirements, specifications and standards specified by the Client. The Services shall be fit for the intended purpose (awareness of which the Consultant acknowledge); 
 
 The Consultant hereby further represent s and warrants to the Client that : 
 
 the Consultant shall comply with all laws, rules and regulations, whether local, regional or national which are applicable to any works or services related to or connected with performance of this Contract, including the applicable labour law of Pakistan ; 
 
 all necessary consents, approvals, licenses, permits authorizations in connection with the services including but not limited to those from any governmental or regulatory body, agency, department, commission, board, bureau or other authority, or such other persons, as the case may be, have been sought and obtained or will be sought, obtained and maintained, by the Consultant at its own cost and expense, from the relevant authorities ; 
 
 the Consultant is in complete compliance with all permits/licenses, including temporary permits/licenses, to provide services etc. of the nature and type under this Contract; and is in complete compliance with all laws, rules and regulations of federal, state or local entities which may have jurisdiction over the Consultant such that any failure of compliance will not have an adverse effect on the Consultant’ s ability to enter, execute, deliver or consummate this Contract ; 
 
 that t here are no proceedings pending, or threatened, ( i ) for its dissolution or bankruptcy or (ii) that could adversely affect the performance of its respective obligations under this Contract or the transactions contemplated hereby ; 
 
 t he execution, delivery and performance of this Contract and the transactions contemplated herein, do not constitute a violation of any Laws of Pakistan and/or any of the Agreements/understandings which any or each of the said Parties are bound by ; 
 
 t here is no labour strike, dispute, slowdown or stoppage actually pending or threatened against or affecting the Consultant ’ s ability to perform its obligations under this Contract ; 
 
 that n o representation or warranty by the Consultant in this Contract, nor any statement or certificate furnished or to be furnished by or on behalf of the Consultant pursuant to this Contract, nor any document or certificate delivered to the Client prior or pursuant to this Contract, or in connection with the transaction contemplated herein, contains or shall contain any false statement of material fact or omits or shall omit a material fact necessary to make the statement contained therein not misleading ; 
 
 that t he Consultant shall take all reasonable measures to meet the timelines set out in this Contract ; 
 
 t he Consultant shall ensure that the Client’s business reputation, name and goodwill are not affected by reason of any default/breach of this Contract caused directly or indirectly by the Consultant or its employees, agents, personnel, executives, sub-contractors, assigns etc ; 
 
 that t he Consultant is validly existing and carrying on its businesses under the Laws of Pakistan and have the legal right and capacity to enter into this Contract ; 
 
 that t he Consultant ha s the power and authority under its constitutive documents, to enter into and perform this Contract and the transaction(s) contemplated hereunder, and their entry into and performance of this Contract and the transaction(s) contemplated by it do not constitute a breach of any obligation or default of such documents and/or any agreement by which they are bound ; 
 
 that t he execution and delivery of this Contract and the consummation of the transaction(s) contemplated hereby have been duly and validly authorized and no other proceedings on part of any person(s) are necessary to authorize this Contract or to consummate the transactions contemplated hereby ; and 
 
 that t he Consultant has the necessary and sufficient skill, training, experience, technical know-how, capacity and resources required for the effective performance of its obligations under this Agreement to the satisfaction of the Client.

 The Client shall use its best efforts to:

 Approvals

 PAYMENTS TO THE CONSULTANT 
 
 Contract Price 
 
 For the Services provided by the Consultant , the Client shall pay to the Consultant fees for Services as specified in Appendix C. 
 
 Payment Schedule 
 
 The Contract Price shall be paid to the Consultant by the Clients upon the successful completion , in accordance with the applicable requirements of this Contract, of each milestone specified in the Payment Schedule in Appendix C. 
 
 After the successful completion of each milestone to the satisfaction of the Client , the Consultant shall submit to the Client, an invoice for payment including any supporting documents. The Client shall pay to the Consultant , subject to any applicable deductions, the applicable milestone payment within thirty (30) days of submission of invoice by the Consultant. 
 
 Mode of Payment 
 
 All payments under this Contract shall be made by the Client to the Consultant through bank instrument in favor of ‘ Jers Consultancy (Pvt) Limited ’ ’ . 
 
 All payment obligations of the Client shall be deemed to be discharged upon payment to the Consultant and shall be considered full and final settlement of the Client’s payment obligations under the Contract. 
 
 
 Consultant ' s Entitlement to Suspend Services 
 
 If the Client fails to make the payment with respect to any invoice of the Consultant within thirty ( 30 ) days from the date of such invoice , the Consultant may after giving not less than thirty (30) days prior notice in writing to the Client, suspend the Services until such time as the invoice is paid by the Client. 
 
 INDEMNITY 
 The Consultant agree s to fully indemnify, hold harmless and defend the Client, its directors, officers, employees, agents and representatives harmless from and against any and all claims, demands, actions, suits, proceedings, liabilities, losses, settlements, judgments, damages, costs and expenses etc. (including but not limited to death or injury to persons), whether or not involving a third party claim, which arise out of or relate to any act, omission and/or breach of any representation or warranty of the Consultant as contained herein, or result from any failure to fulfill, or breach of, obligations of the Consultant hereunder or otherwise owed to the Client. 
 
 The Consultant shall indemnify and hold harmless the Client against any loss, action , claim, expense , damage, suit , proceedings, liabilities and settlements etc. resulting from any error or omission in the design(s ) submitted under this Contract and shall also indemnify the Client against all expense, loss, cost, claim or proceedings etc. suffered or incurred by the Client arising out of or in connection with the infringement or alleged infringement of any copyright registered design patent or other intellectual property right of third parties by any of the Services carried out by the Consultant under this Contract. 
 
 
 8. SETTLEMENT OF DISPUTES 
 
 Amicable Settlement 
 
 The Parties shall use their best efforts to settle amicably all disputes arising out of or in connection with this Contract or its interpretation. 
 
 Dispute Settlement 
 
 Any dispute between the Parties as to matters arising pursuant to this Contract which cannot be settled amicably within fifteen (15) days may, through issuance of notice in writing by either Party to the other Party, in accordance with the provisions of the Arbitration Act, 1940 (Act No. X of 1940) and Rules made thereunder and any statutory modifications thereto. The language of arbitration shall be English and the seat of arbitration will be Lahore. The Services under the Contract shall, if reasonably possible, continue during the arbitration proceedings . 
 
 GENERAL 
 
 Severability 
 
 Should any provision of this Contract be found to be invalid, illegal or unenforceable under the laws of any relevant jurisdiction, the invalid or unenforceable provision shall be given no effect but the remaining provisions of this Contract shall remain in full force and effect. The Parties shall forthwith enter into good faith negotiations to amend the Contract so that the invalid, illegal or unenforceable provision is replaced by a valid, legal, and enforceable provision, which conforms to the extent possible to the intended purpose of the former provision . 
 
 Entire Agreement 
 
 The following documents attached hereto shall be deemed to form an integral part of this Contract: 
 
 This Contract; 
 The following Appendices; 
 
 Appendix A: Scope of Services 
 Appendix B: Key Personnel 
 Appendix C: Payment Schedule 
 
 Any other document that may be duly executed by the Parties in accordance with the terms and conditions of the Contract. 
 
 This Contract and its appendices and any other documents inferred herein constitute the entire agreement and understanding between the Parties with respect to the subject matter contained in this Contract and supersedes and overrides all prior agreements, understandings and negotiations, written or oral, between the Parties. 
 
 Relationship of the Parties 
 
 The Parties intend that the relationship created between them by this Contract shall be as independent contractors. This Contract is not to be construed in any way as creating any partnership, principal-agent, master-servant, joint venture or other similar relationship between the Parties. 
 
 Non-Solicitation 
 
 The Consultant agrees that for a period of eighteen (18) months following the Effective Date of this Contract , the Consultant shall not either directly or indirectly solicit, induce, recruit or encourage any of the Client’s employees to leave their employment, or take away such employees, or attempt to solicit, induce, recruit, encourage, take away or hire employees of the Clients , either for itself or any third party. 
 
 Counterparts 
 
 This Contract may be executed in two or more counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original, but all of which together shall constitute one and same instrument.

 APPENDIX A 
 SCOPE OF SERVICES 
 
 A-1. SCOPE OF SERVICES 
 
 The Consultant will inter alia provide the following services : 
 
 The Consultant will design the plumbing system including water distribution (hot and cold water), sewerage, drainage &amp; irrigation system, firefighting system, sui gas, tanks, swimming pool and all other related systems required for the smooth operation of the Project on the approved plans and layouts. 
 
 The Consultant will design the Electrical &amp; ELV Systems design shall comprise of Illumination, Convenience Power, Data Networking, IBMS, CCTV / Surveillance System, Voice, TV, Fire alarm and detection, Public Address System, Lightning p rotection, e arthing, e mergency UPS, e gress e xit Lighting, s ubstation l ayout, c able t runking &amp; s ingle line diagrams of Electrical Switchgear and all other systems required for the Project. 
 
 The Consultant shall design complete HVAC System which may include DX or c hilled water system i.e. Air cooled Package Unit, Water Cooled Package Unit, VRF system or split air units. HVAC system also include Fresh Air Ducting Layout, Exhaust Air Ducting Layout, Copper Piping Layout, Condensate Drain Layout, and noise control (where required). 
 
 The Consultant will propose the schemes of Electrical, plumbing and HVAC distribution system for the Works for the Client’s selection, keeping in view initial costs, operating costs, and building usage as per standard specifications and legal and zonal regulations of the relevant government agencies, like the CDA, IESCO, etc. 
 
 On approval of the selected suitable scheme, the Consultant will prepare Concept Design drawings based of system selection. 
 
 The Consultant will prepare technical specifications, bill of quantities and layout drawings and an Engineer’s estimate of the cost of the entire MEP installation along with breakdown/Rate analysis. 
 
 Coordinate with the Client for all matters related to the HVAC, Plumbing &amp; Electrical matters of the project. 
 
 The Consultant will assist the Client in finalizing tender documents for floatation and preparation of list of pre-qualified suppliers and contractors. 
 
 The Consultant will assist the Client in evaluation of offers received , prepare bid evaluation reports and preparation of recommendation of awards. 
 
 The Consultant will prepare layout drawings showing details of HVAC, Plumbing and electrical systems, equipment layout, and schedule of installation materials along with standards, specifications and B.O.Q. Details will be sufficient for contractors/suppliers to work on and will provide necessary clarifications when required. 
 
 The Consultant will provide all design calculations including but not limited to Electrical Load Profile, Design Criteria for Selection of Genset &amp; Transformer, Panel and cable schedules, earthing , LPS and short circuit calculation. Cooling load/heating load calculations exhaust air and fresh air calculations. Firefighting system hydraulic calculations and water demand and pipe sizing calculations. 
 
 The Consultant will coordinate with all other discipline i.e. Consultant will coordinate for shafts/duct/openings and for sleeve prior to tender stage. 
 
 The Consultant will be bound to incorporate any comment/ suggestion from Client as per requirement of the Project. 
 
 The Consultant will provide all the submission drawings as per requirement of CDA and other Government agencies. 
 
 
 The Consultant will assist the Client in approval of equipment and material submittals. To avoid delay in the P roject execution, the Consultant shall ensure timely approval of all samples and material to facilitate the trade contractors to deliver these works on time. 
 
 The Consultant will assist the Client in approval of shop drawings and as-built drawings. 
 
 The Consultant will assist the Client in issuing variation orders when required. 
 
 The Consultant will provide top supervision during the construction stage of the works including attending Site coordination meetings. 
 
 Any other work related to HVAC, Electrical and Plumbing required for the successful completion of the Services.
